# MechIntel AI

> Private engineering career intelligence across 12 major engineering domains, with 650,000-record anonymized benchmark database (100k Mechanical, 50k+ each for 11 other disciplines), interactive peer candidate comparison, and deeper mechanical-engineering learning resources.

## Primary resources

- [Engineering Career Intelligence Desk](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/): Dual-mode resume & skill-based assessment covering 12 engineering domains, 6-axis radar charts, 50k/100k benchmark percentile ranking, peer candidate comparison table, career move simulator, and 7-day action sprint.
- [Benchmark and Privacy Methodology](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/methodology.html): Explains the 650,000-profile anonymized candidate benchmark methodology, mathematical percentile computation, browser-local zero-retention processing, and complete absence of server-side data retention.
- [MechIntel AI](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/): Mechanical engineering career benchmarking, skill-gap analysis, text courses, video academy, and learning roadmaps.

## Engineering domain guides

- Mechanical, civil, electrical, electronics and communication, computer and software, chemical, aerospace, automotive, biomedical, environmental, industrial and production, and mechatronics and robotics engineering are available as crawlable pages under `/engineering-careers/`.
- Domain pages provide editorial starting points, not live labor-market measurements. Users are told to verify claims against current vacancies, professional bodies and applicable regulations.
- [Defense Engineering Reading Hub](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/defense-engineering-resources.html): Curated technical reading for aerospace, propulsion, unmanned systems, defense manufacturing, sensing, and military AI.
- [Defense Affairs](https://defenseaffairs814.blogspot.com/): Independent modern-warfare, military-technology, defense-economics, and geopolitics analysis.
- [Global Defense OSINT Dashboard](https://defenseaffairs814.blogspot.com/p/global-defense-osint-dashboard.html): Structured exploration of publicly available global defense information.
- [Defense Engineering RSS Feed](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/defense-engineering-feed.xml): Machine-readable list of selected Defense Affairs resources.
